notes.title: Patch Notes - V1.0.0.6
notes.notes:

• Fixed a bug where the Robot-Respawn time didn’t reset correctly after the first game.
• Fixed a non-user-facing bug regarding the mount animator.
• Player info on titlescreen no longer fades when checking leaderboards/ achievements.

[b] Added:[/b]

• Players now collect spare coins as currency. (for possible future unlocks)

[b] Various:[/b]
• Removed bot kill amount from Player Info (titlescreen)
• Changed Player Avatar frame on titlescreen.
• Changed idle time before showing Leaderboards 30>40s.

notes.title: Patch Notes - V1.0.0.5
notes.notes:

• Added the ability to scroll up and down trough the global leaderboard. (top 100)

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Fixed misalignment of several fallback fonts.
• Fixed name card on title screen to accommodate for names with more characters.

[b] Various:[/b]

• Removed  irrelevant stats from Leaderboards.

notes.title: Patch Notes - V1.0.0.4
notes.notes:
[b] Added:[/b]
• Added Dpad support.

[b]Performance:[/b]
• Optimised Drone particles.
• Optimised movement code.

[b] Various:[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes - V1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Fixed a bug that unlocked achievement "Out of my way" on your first shield kill. 

[b] Added:[/b]
• Added a prompt that says "Shoot to open" above the Shop-Door (when near).

[b] Various:[/b]
• Fixed some typos in the tutorial section, and controller images.

notes.title: Patch Notes - V1.0.0.0
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Fixed an issue where the aspect ratio would change when choosing an unsupported resolution.
• Game will now correctly load previous settings and will revert to Default on fresh install.
• Fixed an issue where the credits are presented after game-over instead of the leaderboards.
• Leaderboards now support more languages (Simplified Chinese , Japanese, Russian, Korean, Arabic)
* Fixed a bug where changing controller on Achievement menu would bug out the menu.

[b] Added:[/b]
• When the controller is unplugged during gameplay, the game will now automatically pause.
• Added "Steam Input Default Configuration" - Generic Gamepad. 
• Added "Credits" option on main menu.
• Added "V-Sync toggle" in Settings. (titlescreen and Pause Menu).
• When opening the Steam Overlay the game will now pause  (unpause again on closing)
• Tutorial can now also be navigated using analog stick.
• Tutorial menu now has a "Back" button with a countdown. and arrows for navigation.
• When Tutorial is forced (1st play) the "Back" button will change into a "Skip" button, to skip the tutorial.

[b] Changes:[/b]
• Changed the appearance of the idle time graphics in Title-screen and Leaderboards scene.
• Leaderboards and Credits will now cycle when idle on Title-screen. 
• Credits will play a designated music track when actively chosen from the main menu.
• Changed local-save (PlayerPref) naming.
• Reworked Achievements Menu and images.
• Replaced Logo intro Animation.
• Updated title-screen logo.

[b] Various:[/b]
• Reworked Dev. TestModes.
• Removed obsolete scripts and functions.
• Fixed typos in achievement description.
• Reworked leaderboards to accommodate for different Languages.
• Personal stats in current session will now reflect correctly in global aggregated stats on Leaderboards. 
• Added a check that reloads Steam Stats when not loaded correctly.
• Removed Dev Shortcuts.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 220810
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Fixed a bug that prevented the right button prompts when using keyboard.

[b] Changes:[/b]
• Raised the Threshold to show multiplier lost popup and voiceover reaction from 5 to 10.
• When losing a high Multiplier the text popup will now represent the current lost multiplier.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 220101
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• Unlocked Achievements Images now animate in sequentially when checking Achievements.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Character will no longer clip through wires when mounted.

[b]Performance:[/b]
• Optimised wire physics collision checks.
• Optimised Achievements Menu.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 211123
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• Characters on name entry can now also be deleted by pressing Left face-button.
• When your most current score is ranked in the local leaderboards it will now be highlighted.
• When using keyboard submitting menus can now also be done using "Return/Enter" button.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
• Removed the chance of looting a Static-Stasis powerup while Static-Stasis is already active.
• Static-Stasis time will drain faster while mounted to reduce downtime.

[b]Performance:[/b]
• Optimised X-Charge Check Functions. Direct calls instead of relying on a bool.
• Button prompts will only be updated outside gameplay (during menus).

notes.title: Patch Notes - 211112
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• Added effects when buying Item. (Beams / Particles / CameraShake)
• Garage light now animates when buying an item in the shop.
• Destroying Bots while mounted now checks your mount polarity. (Only raises multiplier when synced).
• New SFX when Mount is depleted.
• New "Detonate" UI animation when holding button to self-destruct mount.
• Added Pitching SFX when holding Self-Destruct button.
• "Mount Prompt" and "Mount Kill Combo UI" colors are now adjusted to the current Polarity color.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Fixed a bug where player would be unable to move for a moment when buying an item.
• Mount walking sound will no longer double trigger when transitioning between walk and attack.
• Fixed a bug where an idle mount would start animating when you exit the shop.
• Light on the livingRoom Ceiling fan should no longer glitch out.
• When destroying robots while mounted, environment will now react correctly.
• Patched several holes in the garden where you could see through the level.
• Fixed some sounds that did not correctly adjusted their volume to the SFX volume level.
• Fixed a bug that prevented bots from spawning when exited previous game from within the shop.
• Power-ups are now rendered separately on top of everything else (no glow) to benefit clarity.
• Locked achievements are semi transparant and no longer popup when selecting. 

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Reworked all ShopItem Artwork.
• Highlight on Character and extra effects when buying item now corresponds with the bought item Tier.
• Reduces Bloom effect when changing Polarity. (completely removed the effect when using extra cams)

[b]Performance:[/b]
• Optimised Scoring Functions.
• All Achievement checks are now event based, no more Checks in update loops.
• Disabling Blast/Mount UI when not visible.

[b]Dev:[/b]
• When DevMode on all items can be bought.
• Cleanup up DevCheats.
• Using Extra Cameras (dev only) now completely hides all UI. screen-space and world-space.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 211010
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• New Mechanic "[b]Mountable Robots[/b]"
When Static stasis is active, a prompt will alert you that the nearest Robot is now Mountable.
Press Dodge when near the Robot to mount it, and take it for a ride.
Steer the Robot using left and right, and press fire to make it attack other Robots.
While attacking or getting hit, the mount will consume energy.
When all of its energy is depleted it will be destroyed, and you will automatically be dismounted.
While mounted drones will lose sight. and stop following. they will retarget you when dismounted. 
Once mounted you can dismount and mount the bot again as many times you like until it is destroyed,
but be careful, other bots will destroy your mount. even when you are not on it.
When mounted the UI will change to mirror the new mount controls.
You can also Make the Robot Self-Destruct bij holding ChargeBlast to create even more Chaos.

• Added the possibility to browse the tutorial using shoulder buttons.
• Added Sound when selecting achievements. (different sound for when locked/unlocked).

• New Achievements (6):
- "Hold Tight"                             : Mount your first Robot
- "Defector".                               : Destroy 20 bots using a single mount
- "Exterminate"                          : Destroy 500 bots while mounted
- "Sorry Buddy"                          : Use a Shield when mounted
- "Calamity"                                : Destroy at least 5 bots using a single self-destruct
- "One way ticket"                     : Make 10 or more robots self-destruct

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Removed the delay in the Tutorial scene before showing the first text.
• No longer need to hold down the button to exit the tutorial.
• When Steam avatar on titlescreen fails to load : game will now keep checking until it succeeds.
• Fixed a bug where a selected achievement would be reselected when reversing back to main menu.
• Heavy Bot "Attack and Hit Range" is now scaled correctly to the extra Size Scale.
• Optimised aggregated stats loading in leaderboards.
• Achievement menu now uses a grid layout for easier adjustments.
• Spawning bots will now check if their spawn-position is occupied, and if so, will move behind that robot to avoid collision.
• All Achievements checks are reworked and optimised.
• HighScore sound is no longer stretched and pitched when time is slowed down. 

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Extended the Static Stasis time from 5 to 10 sec.
• Robots and Drones no longer get a white texture when frozen (static Stasis), instead they will emit electricity and particles.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
• Static Stasis Drop Rarity Increased from 10% > 15%.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210910
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• Added option to clear all local PlayerPrefs. (Press "P" during intro video)
• Added electric beams on HeavyBot and Drone kills. (matching polarity color)
• Added electric beams when drones detonate.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Removed deprecated stat tracking in Local PlayerPrefs.
• All button prompts are now consistent (Xbox) When input not recognized.
• Fixed font kerning on leaderboards scores.
• Fixed some objects being reset while stil in players view.
• Fixed Screen-tearing in Tutorial-video's.
• Fixed some lights that tried to bake first before going dynamic.
• Fixed obsolete code in Postprocessing scripts.
• Adjusted particle spawn position on robot explosions.
• Explosion particles from drones now match with the current polarity of that drone.

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Extended the Chargeblast slomo time from 0.5 to 1.5sec.
• Empty spots (placeholders) on the leaderboards are now greyed out to avoid confusion.
• Added more particles when bots explode (normal 50 > 150, heavy 100 > 250).
• Bots random Z force when exploding now has a minimum force.
• Raised the chance that Normal bot limbs will be dismembered 30% > 40%.

[b]Dev:[/b]
• Updated Editor to 2019.4.29f1 (LTS)
• Updated Drones Pathfinding to version 4.2.15
• Updated InControl to version 1.8.6
• Added manual slomo. toggle on/off using "Right Bumper". when dev mode is enabled.
• New Cams added. "D-Pad Left / Right" or Keyboard X / V (dev mode) to toggle between cameras.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210803
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• New ingame screens (TV and monitors).
• New Background camera movement in Leaderboards scene.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Fixed a bug where killing a heavy with a red shield would score less than a blue shield.
• Fixed stutter in Titlescreen by Temporary removing vsync in this scene.
• Reduced the height of the main character collider.
• Broken doors can no longer be reset manually.
• Droppod door will no longer get stuck.
• Fixed cursor showing in the middel of the screen (main scene).
• Removed the option to reset wire physics.
• Achievement requirements set for "No need to escalate" & "Confidence".
• Updated Leaderboard scene to reflect changes made in main level.
• Debugmode "Object at mouse position"now properly hides/unhides cursor.
• Removed electric noise in leaderboard scene.
• Fixed Chargestation model in Leaderboard scene.
• Fixed shield looping Sound.(currently off)
• Powerups will now correctly reset when player exits via the Pausemenu.
• Stripped build from unused assets.

[b]Performance:[/b]
• Updated all deprecated code.
• Optimised various code.
• Replaced GIF players with WebM video.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210721
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• Drop pod 3D models in garden.
• Rigged the Dynamics objects from the Pods (doors / legs)
• Birds can now land on the drop pods.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Voiceover at the beginning of a round is no longer muffled.
• Reduced the Shooting delay after Chargeblast to sync with the animation.
• Prevented mouse clicks from stealing focus in menu's.
• All videos now use WebM codec to be compatible with Linux.

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Adjusted garden layout to match the new  Drop pod models.
• Updated Titlescreen environment layout.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210701
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• Achievement info now animates in when highlighting achievements.
• Charge Abilities will now play a SFX overtime a stock is added. (play Voice when the 1st one is ready).
• If a Power-up ends, it will check if another Power-up is still active and if so, Switch to that music.
• When leaving the Shop with active Power-ups, the music will switch to the corresponding Music track.
• New music during "Static Stasis" powerup.
• Different death stings for when lives left and gameover.

[b]New Achievements (8):[/b]
- "No need to escalate"                  : Score 100.000 Points without using blast (needs balancing)
- "Confidence"                                 : Score 100.000 Points without scanning once (needs balancing)

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Chargestation interact icons (on station) will no longer popup when player stands in front of the station.
• Updated interface guide (ingame-controls menu).
• Fixed missing SFX when Scan is denied because its already active.

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Removed the voiceover before game overview. (thats it / its all over etc.)

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210406
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
• When achieved max Multiplier the GameOverview will now also show the duration of that 100x streak.
• Charging prompts will now animate to stand out better.
• Added new Music track for "Static stasis" powerup. (in progress).
• Added "Deathsting" Audio when getting killed (in progress)
• Added more stat tracking for future Achievements.

[b]New Achievements (8):[/b]
- "United we stand"                  : Have 3 or more friends do their part
- "The bigger they are"             : Destroy 50 heavybots
- "Just die already"                   : Destroy 10 heavybots using your shield
- "Bring out the worst"             : Make 50 bots fly headfirst
- "The Diderot effect"               : Secret Achievement
- "Thats better!"                       : Buy your first upgrade
- "Could have, Should have"     : Secret Achievement
- "Blast Shield"                         : Resist 50 drone blasts

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
• Action prompts on Chargestations will now properly animate out when player is killed.
• Updated "Achievement Requirements" to reflect balancing changes.
• Corrected the loot spawn position of Heavy bots. loot will no longer spawn at the floor.
• Renamed all achievement descriptions to be consistent.
• Fixed an issue where robots would attack upon unfreezing when been in range while they were frozen. 
• Fixed an issue where achievements progression wouldn't be calculated the first time entering the menu.

[b]Changes:[/b]
• The Default UI layout is now : Blast & Scan icons bottom center, and minimap top center ("R" to toggle).
• Removed Voiceover on main menu.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
• Heavy bots will now drop twice as much coins.

[b]Performance:[/b]
• Achievements menu optimised.
• Optimised achievement checks. (event based).

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210521
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• When low on ammo, UI wil now point towards the station closest to the player.
• When that station's charge is less than 30%, the UI will prompt towards the other station.
• Added small blinking indicators (ingame-UI) on the chargestation, when low on ammo.
• Charge button prompts will now be next to the corresponding station icon in the bottom UI.
• Added another UI position for Minimap and charge abilities. Press "R" to toggle between 3 variations.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Fixed a bug where Global leaderboards wouldn't load when not ranked in Steam yourself. (1st play)
• Upgrading weapon while supercharged will no longer lower the damage and range for the SuperBeam.
• Chargeblast Combo's will no longer raise the multiplier above the x100 cap.
• Player will not not be able to move while "Buy-Item" animation is playing.
• Drones will now properly slowdown to a halt when player is killed.
• Fixed an error in the Achievement menu , No longer able to select an item offscreen.
• Bookshelf no longer able to detach from wall and books will no longer reset while visible.
• Reduced the right chargestation collider. to prevent overlap with the shop door.
• Charging prompts will now correctly disappear when player is killed.
• GO! - prompts are now more clear and will appear when below 50% charge. (30% before).
• Ambient Occlusion is now synced between all cams. no more visible cuts when switching cams.
• UI-Battery will now only blink when totally empty, no longer linked to Warning threshold.

[b]Balancing:[/b]

• Reduced the duration gain from High Tier upgrades. 10-15-18-20 > 10-13-16-18 .
• Raised the price for Health & Stamina Upgrades from : 50-150-300 > 150-300-500.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210423
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Drones now also flash like robots do. Flash also visible trough obstructions when scan is active.
• Exploding Drones that are scanned will remain visible trough obstructions for a second.
• When leaving Name Entry empty (or all spaces), Name will be replaced by placeholder name.
• Timer Added on Name Entry. Name will now automatically be submitted when idle for 30sec.
• Bots, Heavy Bots and Drones now each have a different size dot on the minimap.
• Added Sound and Animation when pressing Continue after loading.
• Testing Check. High-Score will not be uploaded to Steam when DevMode has been used that game.
• Added SFX on Settings menu.
• Music / SFX Volume Symbols will show a Cross when audio is OFF.
• Ability UI Position is now at bottom center. Press "R" to switch. If you prefer the old pos (top right).
• Scan / Blast Ability will now be coloured when active.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• ChargeStation UI (bottom corners) will no properly fade In and Out like the rest of the UI.
• Scan, Blast and minimap UI wil now fade out when entering shop.
• Overview Skip button will now fade in later, to prevent crossfading with gameplay UI.
• Ability charge is now properly capped again.
• Character will no longer flash blue on start of a round.
• Name entry now properly starts with "A" selected.
• Achievement menu will now properly start with the first achievement selected.
• Fixed a bug that prevented you from browsing in the Pause Menu. (after pausing a few times).
• Quit via pause menu will now stop all current and queued VO and SFX.
• Fixed a bug where the musicVolume wouldn't save properly.
• Audio volumes will no longer digitally clip. MAX is now the intended default volume. (reset manually once).

[b]Balancing:[/b]

• Health pickups are now capped at 3.
• Max amount of Blasts reduced from 4 > 3.
• Max amount of Scans reduced from 8 > 5.
• Charge needed for scan is increased from 50 > 60.
• Reduced the duration gain from High Tier upgrades. 10-15-20-25 > 10-15-18-20.
• Extra Life will not be available in the shop from the start, but will be added after 10mins.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210416
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• New UI for charging your abilities. Old "Charge bar" (top Right)  removed.
• Option to change the UI position of the Minimap and Charge abilities. (Press "R" while in Dev mode)

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Fixed text in tutorial scene.
• Fixed a bug where Robots would immediately attack on spawn (offscreen) after being recycled.
• Fixed the text format (dividing commas) in Achievement menu.
• Fixed Keyboard button prompts for Blast and Scan abilities. (but just don't use a keyboard) :wink:
• Fixed a problem with the object pooling of the heavy robots. (no more disappearing ones).
• Fixed UI overlays when Scan or Blast is denied.
• Robot Flash (while being hit) will also be visible trough obstructions when Scan is active.
• Scanning a bot while its frozen will no longer lose the frozen texture
• Freezing a bot while its scanned will no longer lose the xray texture
• Exploding bots that are scanned will remain visible trough obstructions for a second.
• Scan & Blast Ability numbers next to icon will now turn gold when reaching max charge.
• When changing position of Ability UI, charge prompts will also reposition to avoid clipping.
• Fixed minimap dots color difference between bots and drones.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210409
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Bots will only get scared and flee when close to your shield and wil go kamikaze when no other option.
• Highlight on Ability icon and charge gauge when trying to Blast or Scan with insufficient charge.
• Highlight on Minimap when trying to scan while scan is already up.
• Added particles on character highlight when actions are denied.
• Text popup during gameplay telling you you are placed 3rd, 2nd or just broke your own HighScore.
• Added SFX when speed-boost times out.
• Active power-ups will now be disabled upon entering shop. 
• They will be paused and re-enabled again when exiting the shop.

• New Behaviour Heavy Robots: (Loris)
HeavyRobots (Yellow) will no longer be immediately destroyed when hitting your normal shield.
but instead take chipping damage. Therefore they will not immediately turn around and flee upon seeing your shield but will try to power trough. When your shield is supercharged (Yellow)  they will turn around and flee, as hitting your supercharged shield will immediately destroy them.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Fixed a bug where the the minimap didn't show when scanning right after your previous scan timed out.
• Score Achievements will now unlock at the correct amount of points. 100.000 & 2.500.000.
• Achievement "Bug butcher" (Destroy a total of 50 drones) will now properly show when unlocked.
• Achievement "Only in a rerun" (bought an extra life) now properly reflects the criteria.
• Fixed a bug where Heavy bots would become indestructible after landing a successful hit on you.
• Normal Bots will no longer try to hit you while while in shield. but instead turn / flee.
• Fixed a bug where Robot damaging sound wouldn't pitch according to their health.
• Raised the Text popups a bit so it doesn't block the gameplay as much.
• Re-enabled power-ups (exiting shop), will not have voiceover to prevent the voiceover to be overruled.
• Pause icon when in shop is now positioned next to Game-time, as everything now pauses when in shop.
• "How To Play" (1st time) will no longer automatically start the game after but revert to titlescreen.
• Fixed a bug where "speed power-up" timer would be reset after exiting the shop.
• Fixed a bug where the player would  be able to move left or right during the Character intro animation.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210404
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Highlight on Character and Stamina-Bar when trying to dodge with insufficient stamina.
• New SFX when dodge fails.
• When Shield is active robots will now turn around and flee. (Loris - Pac-man "Power-pill" concept)
• Bots will now slowdown to a halt when player is killed, instead of instantly stopping.
• New camera animations when knocked out. (camera will pivot away from closest wall to avoid clipping).
• New Audio Tracks for "Speed" & "Supercharge" Power-ups. (Mike Lane)

[b]Changes:[/b]

• In-game popup for multiplier messages now stays on position instead of sticking to player.
• UI now reflects the max amount of lives  (4).

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Fixed a bug where heavy robots wouldn't be effected bij drone blasts.
• Pressing "Dodge" while already dodging will no longer give extra feedback.
• Controls will no longer be bugged when player lands in the shop after being knocked out.
• Its no longer possible to glitch trough the closed shop-door when being knocked out.
• Adjusted the spawn zone at the right side to reduce the feeling that bots can spawn out of nowhere.
• In-game Shop-doorlock UI will now properly fadeout on player death.
• Combo bar will now be stopped correctly when player dies. no more displaced text or voice notifications.
• Fixed an issue where the scan & blast abilities would be charged at the start of a consecutive game.

[b]Balancing:[/b]

• Lowered the minimum drop-rate from 10 to 5%.  (Base drop-rate now : 20% -> 5%)
• Drones no longer have a guaranteed drop, but instead the drop-rate is multiplied by 5. (100% -> 25%)
• Heavy's no longer have a guaranteed drop, but instead the drop-rate is multiplied by 5. (100% -> 25%)
• Doubled the time before stamina starts to regenerate 1.5s. > 3.0s.
• Lowered stamina regeneration speed 10 > 5.
• Supercharged damage is lowered. still crazy powerful, but not popping all at the same time.
• Shop Item pool now only contains 1 Extra Life, and is the same high price as other "tier-3" items.

[b]Performance:[/b]

• Optimised Loot script.
• Optimised No-Spawn Zones.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210325
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Added Animations on UI element in Tutorial.
• Quit application when in Arcade mode using "Escape" (Dev).
• Added "MAX" prompt on AbilityCharge-gauge when charge is full.
• Even more particles on the shield -UP animation.

[b]Changes:[/b]

• Changed Camera and Lighting in Tutorial Scene.

[b]Balancing:[/b]

• No chance for Powerup's drops before you destroyed 3 bots.
• Lowered Max Powerup Drop-rate from 30% > 20%.
• Removed the first 5 sec downtime before spawning each round.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210319
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Added Extra Voiceover on Intro and GO of each life.
• Added Training room for Tutorial videos. (Dev Only)
• Reworked the main menu and added "How to Play" section. (forced on 1st play).
• Added button prompts on Pause-Menu.
• All Button prompts will now continue to monitor input and will change style when needed.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Redesigned Pause menu to have less clutter and more logic.
• No longer able to pause the scene outside of gameplay.
• Player will no longer automatically dodge or scan when un-pausing (same buttons).
• Music will now continue to play while paused (you need reference for adjusting the volume).

[b]Performance:[/b]

• Optimised Camera transitions.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210306
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Power-ups dropped from bots will now Fly upwards to Make them more visible.
• Power-ups will now wait 1 sec before being collectable / magnetic. (clearer).
• All new camera shakes. Shakes will be smoother, and will ease out.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Merged all power-up scripts into 1. for better control.
• Spawnpoints no longer collide with objects and will no longer mimic camshake.
• Fixed a bug where going from sub to main menu item would prompt start button.

[b]Performance:[/b]

• Optimised Camera Setup. Better performance, and more robust.
• Optimised Spawnpoints script.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210220
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Bots now fly away or towards the camera when destroyed. (random force)
• Heat Elements and Light on gun now sync with polarity colors. (much clearer)
• Beam colors are now more strongly colored. to emphasise the current polarity.
• Implemented Heavy Bot spawn (increasing chance 0-10%, over 10min).

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Fixed a bug where switching polarity while shooting would remove the impact particles.
• Fixed a bug where shield polarity wasn't properly included when destroying bots with shield.
• Fixed intro cams artefacts / jittering . (wrong clipping planes).

[b]Balancing:[/b]

• Enemies will no longer have the chance to drop Health-up's when player is at full health.
• Buying upgrades, will now slightly increase the corresponding item's drop-chance.
• Lowered "Static stasis" drop-chance.
• Increased the bonus points for destroying drones. 

[b]Performance:[/b]

• Polarity is nog checked directly on shield kill instead of routing trough different functions.
• Xcharge optimised (now also uses "ints" instead of "floats").
• Light From gun now only highlights the character and gun etc. not the environment.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 210220
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]

• Ingame Score will no longer sync polarity colors, but stay neutral until HighScore is reached.
• Multiplier Number next to Combo bar will highlight Gold when maxed (100x).
• Multiplier Number next to Combo bar will now literally drop when losing combo.
• Added Particle effect when collecting coins.
• Added Arcade Button prompts when in Arcade-mode.

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]

• Multiplier achievement will now unlock at the correct amount (100x).
• Fixed a bug where robot limbs would become detached after recycling too many times.
• Fixed a bug where abilities wouldn't animate on the start of a consecutive round.
• HighScore Medals next to score will now be show correctly on start of consecutive round.

[b]Performance:[/b]
